name: acornaut-shell
description: The native shell around the Acornaut web bundle: Capacitor for iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). The game itself lives in ../illustrated-src and ships from ../docs; this folder only wraps it.

scripts.ios: node build-web.mjs && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: node build-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
